scope: Read-only audit of the newly clarified intermittent Iconbox click/double-click freeze/restart report; no personal window was activated and no process was restarted.

observations.pointer_path: A left click is frozen to the task record, then selectRecord validates its key/PID and updates selection/open-member-selector state. MouseArea.onDoubleClicked marks the gesture dispatched and emits an immutable current-record snapshot carrying the first click's active state; doubleClickRecord validates it and requests minimize or activate/restore.
observations.existing_native_evidence: R37 used the same three source/installed hashes and passed 44 isolated native checks, including active-window minimize and second-double-click restore/focus. This does not cover the reported intermittent production-session restart.
observations.indexed_coredumps: The only indexed plasmashell dumps are from 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-26, from separate bridge instances already reviewed in R607/R608; neither correlates to this new report.

result: The production code and R37-tested code are identical. The click route has no reproduction or newly evidenced crash in this audit. No code change is justified by the available evidence; this does not establish that the intermittent symptom is fixed.
remaining: Correlate a future occurrence with an approximate timestamp and PID/journal/coredump from the lsi plasmashell instance.
If a repeatable synthetic sequence or a concrete stale-record race is found, correct only P04 and validate with test-owned clients.
limitations: No exact time or application identity was supplied for the reported occurrence.
No click was injected into personal applications or the live panel during this read-only audit.
Existing Xephyr evidence is isolated native evidence, not proof of the production-only intermittent restart.
